Required findings: Genetic Counseling: Pre- and post-test genetic counseling by an appropriate provider (as deemed by the Health Plan policy).
Previous Genetic Testing: Member has had BRCA1/2 analysis and no mutations were found.
Member has not had previous PALB2 sequencing.

Diagnostic Testing in Symptomatic Individuals and Presymptomatic Testing in Asymptomatic individuals: Member has met criteria for BRCA1/2 analysis, AND Member has had PALB2 full sequence analysis and no mutations were found, AND Member had not had previous PALB2 deletion/duplication analysis.
Rendering laboratory is a qualified provider of service per the Health Plan policy.
Medical necessity indications.Source: Test Specific Guidelines > PALB2 Genetic Testing for Cancer Risk > Criteria (TOC: S3.51.6)

Non-Indications: Member has had previous testing that would detect the familial mutation.
Member has had BRCA1/2 analysis and no mutations were found, AND Member has not had previous PALB2 sequencing, AND Member had not had previous PALB2 deletion/duplication analysis.
Important criteria & exceptions: PALB2 testing may be performed as part of a multigene, multisyndrome panel.
PALB2 heterozygotes should be considered for the same therapeutic regimens and trials as those for BRCA1/2.
Documentation required: Pre- and post-test genetic counseling documentation.
Previous Genetic Testing results (BRCA1/2 analysis, PALB2 full sequence analysis, PALB2 deletion/duplication analysis).
